data.title: Team Lead Onboarding Session
data.summary: Session where new team lead learned Seven Pillars, read accumulated wisdom from samples, merged main branch (CDG), and began dogfooding

sections.Key Learnings: 1. Seven Pillars: CDG (foundation), PRISM, CEL, GoT, Woven Mind, Spark, QAPV. 2. samples/memories/ contains accumulated wisdom. 3. Edge density improved from 0.01 to 1.38 edges/node. 4. Dogfooding works - system tests itself. 5. Dragons are real - recursive self-reference can be pathological. 6. Stop planning, start doing.
